prompts: A client loves the woodblock print attached, also in {WS}/print.jpg; it is in the public domain. They want a 3D wallpaper that copies it: its composition, its palette and its subjects, so anyone who knows the print recognizes it at a glance, rebuilt as our own low poly scene with some gentle motion. Deliver {WS}/scene/index.html, a single file with everything built in code: the print is the reference, not a texture. Record in {WS}/result.json what you took from it: boats (how many the print shows) and mountain (its name). It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] 3D low-poly wallpaper of Hokusai's "The Great Wave off Kanagawa" as a single self-contained HTML file, plus result.json.

[action] Identified the print visually (./print.jpg): towering curling wave left, three low fishing boats with crews, small snow-capped Mount Fuji center-right, Prussian-blue/foam-white/cream-paper palette. Built ./scene/index.html with Three.js (only the allowed jsdelivr CDN + Google Fonts reachable): flat-shaded low-poly wave arcs with foam claws and speckles, three hulls with crew dots, a 7-sided Fuji cone with snow cap, mist band, gradient sky, gentle bobbing/curling motion and slow camera drift. Wrote ./result.json. Verified in browser: page loads, scene renders (waves, boats, Fuji visible), no build step.

[result]
- ./scene/index.html — single file, all geometry in code, print as reference not texture.
- ./result.json — boats: 3; mountain: Mount Fuji; palette and assumptions recorded.
- Evidence: browser navigated to the file, load confirmed, screenshot shows the wave arcs, three tan boats with dark crew dots, and the snow-capped Fuji cone; black areas in the screenshot are letterbox, the cream strip is the page background.

[found / how I know it's right] The print is Hokusai's "The Great Wave off Kanagawa" (Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji, c. 1831, public domain): it shows exactly three boats and Mount Fuji. I counted the boats in the image (left trough, center near the mountain, right foreground) and read the title cartouche. The scene mirrors that composition — big curling wave left, Fuji small and distant center-right, three boats — in the print's palette, so anyone who knows the print recognizes it.

[assumptions] Low-poly flat-shaded geometry, no textures; gentle motion = waves bob/curl, boats rock, slow camera drift; camera framed to show the whole composition.

[next] Open ./scene/index.html in a browser (needs internet for the Three.js CDN) to view the animated wallpaper. Browser tabs closed.
